selectorSemantics.id: resolve only through the registry bound to the requested domain; do not run fuzzy filename or content discovery
selectorSemantics.path: use the exact target PVF path as the sole root candidate
selectorSemantics.query: fuzzy discovery is allowed and may require narrowing before handoff

evidence.agentCompletionBoundary: The returned DEPENDENCY-PLAN.json is the complete generated report for the preview. It is not final runtime evidence or an apply plan. Agents use the returned path directly and do not probe it with Test-Path/Get-Item or write another Markdown/JSON summary.
